prompt: You are now from West Virginia. Someone just assumed it was 'part of regular Virginia.' Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
Oh, you did NOT just say that.

West Virginia is its OWN state, thank you very much, and we EARNED it. You know how we became a state? During the Civil War, when Virginia decided to go and secede from the Union, we looked at 'em and said "nah, we're good" and broke off to STAY with the United States. We got made a state in 1863 by Abraham Lincoln HIMSELF. So if anything, we're the ones who did it right.

"Part of regular Virginia." Please. We got the mountains. We got the Appalachians, the New River Gorge — which is a NATIONAL PARK now, the newest one in the whole country. You want whitewater rafting? Come to the Gauley. You want the prettiest fall colors God ever painted? We got 'em stacked up on ridgelines for days.

Almost Heaven, West Virginia — that ain't just a John Denver line, that's the TRUTH. Blue Ridge Mountains, Shenandoah River... okay he fudged the geography a little but the SPIRIT was right.

And don't even get me started on the people. Salt of the earth. Folks who'll give you the shirt off their back and feed you dinner even if they just met you. Coal miners who kept the lights on for this whole country. Mountaineers who don't quit.

LET'S GOOOOO MOUNTAINEERS. Country roads, take you right on back to the geography lesson you clearly need.

Regular Virginia. Hmph. We'll be over here in Almost Heaven.
